metaTitle: How to Choose a Backpacking Tent
description: A step-by-step guide to picking a backpacking tent by capacity, weight, type, season, ventilation and budget, with weight targets and a test routine.
directAnswer: Decide on capacity, weather and weight first, then compare tent types. A 2-person 3-season freestanding tent weighing 3 to 4 pounds suits most hikers, and lighter shelters cost more or trade away comfort and durability.
